LESSON: HADITH ON GREETINGS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.1 Hadith on good Behaviour (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub - strand, 
Topic 2.2: Hadith on Greetings

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on Greetings. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: which, if you do, you will love one another?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society
2. appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH ON GREETINGS
This lesson teaches Hadith on Greetings for Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith on Greetings using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith on Greetings above.
2. Explain Hadith on Greetings to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith on Greetings.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Greetings with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Greetings important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which, if you do, you will love one another?
2. Why should a Muslim use Islamic greeting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society
2. appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
